status: PROPOSAL - findings require reconfirmation by the single writer against live

method.connectivity_model: Wire-stub topology. Every one of the 675 wires on this sheet is a geometrically isolated stub carrying a NET attribute; there are zero wire-to-wire junctions and no NETLABEL/NETFLAG/NETPORT primitives. Net membership is therefore: pin coordinate coincides with a stub endpoint, and the net is that stub's NET attribute.
method.registration: jobs/all-pins-nc-audit.results.json predates the frozen source for some components. A 2-parameter translation per component was fitted so that the resulting connected/floating set reproduces EasyEDA's own DRC floating-pin list exactly. 219/228 components fit at offset (0,0); U9-ESP at (-5,-20); C10-PWR2 at (0,-5); 7 components do not fit exactly and are excluded.
oracle_fault_battery: wire deletion -> pin reports FLOATING (RED, observed)
pin displaced 1 unit -> pin reports FLOATING (RED, observed)
stub NET renamed -> pin net membership changes (RED, observed)
injected known offset -> fitter recovers it exactly (RED then GREEN, observed)
stub endpoint removed -> registration fit fails to UNRESOLVED (RED, observed)
method.external_denominator: EasyEDA schematic DRC log anchors/schDrcLog_2026-08-28.txt (195 floating-pin entries) - not derived from this audit.

coverage.scope_pin_coverage: 100% - every pin of every in-scope component is classified
known_gaps: U6-RTC (MIMXRT1062DVJ6B) pin readback covers 98 balls; EasyEDA DRC names 111 floating U6-RTC pins of which 73 are outside that readback. Where an in-scope net crosses into the RT1062 the far-side ball can be named only for balls inside the readback.

AUDIO_BCLK_RT terminates on an RT1062 ball at sheet (2415,4660), inside the U6-RTC symbol extent but outside the 98-ball readback. EasyEDA DRC does NOT list AUDIO_BCLK_RT among its single-pin nets, so the connection exists; the ball cannot be named from this evidence. UNVERIFIED, not a defect.
R30-AUD is absent from the board: the -AUD designator sequence skips it.
